info.title: Fault Code API
info.description: Versioned Fault Code API with public synthetic foundation operations and protected caller permissions. Dedicated Entra v2 bearer validation is available when configured; protected operations require delegated scopes or application roles under FAU-9. Browser clients use authorization code + PKCE; machines use client credentials. No tenant has been provisioned and no placeholder OAuth URLs are executable.

get.description: Requires users.manage. Delegated: exact scope users.manage AND one of roles Administrator. Application: exact role Users.Manage.Application. Caller kind: Either. Local administration metadata only; no Entra grant or external provider activation. Production adapter unavailable503 pending approved persistence and identity/provider integration. Mutations atomically store trusted tenant/actor/client/correlation audit and scoped replay; strong If-Match and Idempotency-Key required.

post.description: Requires faults.read. Delegated: exact scope faults.read AND one of roles Reader, Operator, Engineer, Administrator. Application: exact role Faults.Read.All. Caller kind: Either. Requires vehicles.read. Delegated: exact scope vehicles.read AND one of roles Reader, Operator, Engineer, Administrator. Application: exact role Vehicles.Read.All. Caller kind: Either. Alternatively exact vehicles.read.own scope AND Reader role; application own-read is unavailable. Trusted record authorization remains required. Requires knowledge.read. Delegated: exact scope knowledge.read AND one of roles Reader, Operator, Engineer, Administrator. Application: exact role Knowledge.Read.All. Caller kind: Either. Ephemeral bounded advisory runtime; no incident mutation or durable run history. Exact faults.read, vehicles.access.read and knowledge.read plus trusted intake ownership. Empty request only; no supplied identity/prompt/tools. Disabled503 until explicit snapshot/secret; production incident storage503 pending DEC-001. Engineering review required; output is not approved guidance or completed investigation. Each call incurs a new run; no idempotent/billing replay is claimed.

post.description: Requires knowledge.publish. Delegated: exact scope knowledge.publish AND one of roles Engineer. Application: exact role Knowledge.Publish.Application. Caller kind: Either. Bounded synthetic extracted pages, not URL/binary ingestion. knowledge.publish manages documents, immutable approvals, deletion and explicit indexing; knowledge.read searches only current approved tenant/publisher-visible exact applicability. Draft edits never replace approved evidence. Index/search503 if canonical storage, explicitly pinned embeddings or compatible Qdrant are unavailable. Production canonical store503 pending DEC-001/003. Reindex rebuilds only this tenant; retry key scopes actor/client/operation/profile. Returned source text is untrusted, conflicts unadjudicated; no generation, repair guidance, GraphRAG or tool execution.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1-100 ASCII letters/digits/hyphen/underscore; scoped exact retry returns original result, changed payload409. Use a new key for a new reindex after index loss.

get.description: Requires drivers.read. Delegated: exact scope drivers.read AND one of roles Reader, Operator, Engineer, Administrator. Application: exact role Drivers.Read.All. Caller kind: Either. Alternatively exact drivers.read.own scope AND Reader role; application own-read is unavailable. Trusted record authorization remains required. Storage returns 503 until DEC-001 durable persistence is approved/configured. Read access accepts exact all-read permission OR Reader+own-read scope, then applies trusted tenant/owner filtering before count/page. All x-faultcode-required-policies are ANDed. Writes require strong If-Match where declared; create replay is actor/client/operation/payload scoped. DELETE soft-deactivates or ends an association. Unowned vehicles are excluded from reads.
